title: Primitive vs Western Diet
body:
The most important book on health is “Nutrition and Physical Degeneration” which was
published in 1939 by Doctor Weston Price. For 10 years he and his wife traveled the world in
the 1930s documenting hundreds of primitive tribes in 14 different countries before and after
influence of modern civilization.(1)
These primitives were very strong and healthy and, additionally, they all had straight teeth,
white teeth, and no cavities. However, when introduced to the western diet they all got
cavities and the next generation of children were born with crowded jaw, crooked teeth,
narrower nostrils, and narrower eye openings. Dr. Price documented this with hundreds of
photographs.
Later, primitive people were found to have very low rates of nearsightedness. “While fewer
than one per cent of the Inuit and Pacific islanders had myopia early in the last century, these
rates have since skyrocketed to as high as 50 per cent. These overnight epidemics have
usually been blamed on the increase in reading following the sudden advent of literacy and
compulsory schooling in these societies.
“But while reading may play a role, it does not explain why the incidence of myopia has
remained low in societies that have adopted Western lifestyles but not Western diets. “In the
(pacific) islands of Vanuatu they have eight hours of compulsory schooling a day, yet the rate
of myopia in these children is only two per cent. The difference is that Vanuatuans eat fish,
yam and coconut rather than white bread and cereals.” (2)
High rates of nearsightedness for primitive tribes with primitive lifestyles would greatly reduce
their chance of survival. If nearsightedness was strictly a genetic anomaly, it would have
disappeared from the gene-pool thousands of years ago.
Doctor Price attributed such changes to white flour, sugar, and vegetable oil. I can see how
white flour and sugar could explain the cavities but how could any of those dietary factors
explain genetic changes in one generation?
Doctor Prices intuition was incredible. It was mainly due to vegetable oil because vegetable
oil is made from seeds. Plants provide fruit for animals to eat in exchange for helping to
spread the seeds but most plants evolved with substances to discourage animals from eating
the seeds. Most seeds are highly toxic with cyanide, strychnine,and arsenic being common
chemical protections.Edible grains and legumes contain weaker toxins that can be destroyed
by cooking. However, another plant protection discovered recently is microRNA which is not
destroyed by cooking.

It is true that the purpose of most plant microRNA is the growth and development of the seed
into a plant but plant microRNA has been shown to have a negative effect on human
development and function.
An article published in Scientific American, December 1, 2011, states: “Although microRNAs
do not code for proteins, they prevent specific genes from giving rise to the proteins they
encode. A specific rice microRNA was shown to bind to and inhibit the activity of receptors
controlling the removal of LDL—“bad” cholesterol—from the bloodstream.” (3) Rice has 3999
other microRNA segments that may have negative effects yet to be identified. Wheat has a
much lower 68 microRNA segments while Quinoa (an ancient grain) has only 3. The popular
vegetable oils, Rapeseed (Canola) has 882, Soy has 600, Corn has 280, Olive has 135
microRNA segments.
Since microRNA can affect human growth and development at a genetic level, the genetic
change observed by Doctor Price in one generation could be explained by a diet high in plant
microRNA, some of which has likely evolved as plant defense mechanisms.
On the subject of rice, orientals have lower worldwide average levels of cholesterol.(4) How is
that possible? Since rice has been consumed by orientals for over 2500 years, those that
could not handle the diet died off over that time. If the crowed jaw, crooked teeth, narrower
nostrils, and narrower eye openings that Dr. Price observed is taken to extreme, the result is
oriental features. They are a genetically selected race. Europe and America have the highest
rates of cholesterol maybe because genetic selection due to rice consumption is just
beginning there.
At the same time, the rates of myopia for orientals is over 90%, much higher than world
averages. Rice and soy are very likely major factors.
I recommend avocado oil for cooking and mayonnaise as it is the only vegetable oil not made
with the seed because the seed is too toxic. Use strained tomato sauce for spaghetti sauce
and ketchup because the seeds and the skin are removed. Cook beans and lentils in a
pressure cooker. The higher temperatures destroy more of the toxins. Eat quinoa instead of
rice. Peel vegetables and fruits if possible because the peal will have a higher level of plant
pesticides than the fruit. If pregnant, consider a Paleo diet but do not eat pork. (5)
